fields.name: Dabid Shochney
fields.bio: I am into modern contemporary art. I love manipulating dimensions that give a different view of things. I hope to bring some inspiration to you through my art. Enjoy!

fields.name: Vablo Vicasso
fields.bio: Why couldn't art just be a conundrum of shapes, wouldnt life just be easier. Have a look at my artwork that takes complex objects and places it into paintings by using shapes. A unique look on the world is here. Enjoy!

fields.name: Benny Gaville
fields.bio: I am in touch with the human nature and life's lessons. I have found it quite interesting to express life through humanistic art. Hope you will enjoy my expressions and admire them as much as i do. Cheers!

fields.name: Herald Richie
fields.bio: From a very young age i enjoyed painting as a form of expression. I find inspiration in mostly anything and everything. Hope you enjoy having a look at my various art pieces, if you like them a lot, im sure they would love to be a piece in your home.

fields.name: Hantony Hormley
fields.bio: After my many travels, I am simply fascinated by the art provided by the most unexpected thing, the human body. My major art forms are in the vicinity of sculpting and without any surprise my major subject is the human body. Feel free to check out my art and enjoy.

fields.name: Bibi Smithers
fields.bio: After life experiences, I have expressed many art through life experiences, not just my own life's experience but many others. Have a look at my pieces, are you able to tell the life story from it.....have a closer look!

fields.name: Keff Joons
fields.bio: Art to me is so variable, however, sculpting has been my major passion. Have a open mind when looking at my art, then you will see. Enjoy

fields.name: Banishe Lapoor
fields.bio: I am into various types of art but sculpting has taken my heart. I hope you love my art as much as I love creating them. Enjoy.

fields.name: Balton Hord
fields.bio: As a kid, I have always had a passion for appreciating and replicating various sceneries and landscapes. My later and ultimate passion later fell for understanding animals and observing their relationship towards humans. A lot of my later art depicts animal relationship with us humans. Have a look at my art, the art will speak for itself what i cannot say in words. Enjoy!

fields.name: Malvaro Bastagnet
fields.bio: Art is so subjective, isnt it. Look at my art what do you see! Enjoy

fields.name: Stephen Yang
fields.bio: Well Well, Love to see you here. All art is precious. Have a look at some of my work and if you like to have some at yours then the pleasure is all mine. Enjoy!

fields.name: Josephine Bowik
fields.bio: From a young age I have had a fascination with colours. Colours light up our life. I hope you enjoy my art as much as `i have enjoyed creating them. Cheers!
